source_title: ‘We are not in Disneyland’: Arteta warns Dowman of Arsenal’s demands
source_excerpt:
‘We have made these mistakes … you can get punished’
‘We have made these mistakes … you can get punished’
Dowman lost appeal against red card at Fleetwood
Dowman lost appeal against red card at Fleetwood
Mikel Arteta has warned Max Dowman that he “is not in Disneyland” and must learn from his red card against Fleetwood after Arsenal’s appeal against his three-match suspension was rejected.
The 16-year-old became the youngest player ever to be sent off in the League Cup on Tuesday as the Premier League champions crashed out to the League Two side Fleetwood. Arteta said he was “very disappointed” that the Football Association rejected the appeal against his red card and felt Dowman was lucky not to suffer a broken foot from “reckless tackles”.
But despite describing his reaction as “minimal”, the Arsenal manager revealed he had spoken to Dowman this week to underline his responsibilities after he was also sent off this month playing for England Under 19s.
“I’ve done it, so I try to prevent that [in future]. That’s why I’m so protective of these things and especially with young players, because we have made those mistakes. You know how much you can get punished and how much it can change what happens next, and it’s not the first time, so obviously we need to put an end to it very, very quickly,” Arteta said.
Arteta said he had not seen the criticism of his angry reaction to Dowman’s red card, when he appeared to aim a few choice words towards the forward as he headed down the tunnel. But he defended his actions after warning Dowman he was likely to be targeted before the game. “It’s something that we discussed just before we went out, because it’s not the first time that happened,” he said.
“For me, it was the best reaction ever to be able to be who I am. You want to see the reaction of his teammates? When they have to play with 10, you want to see that? That’s the level, and that’s the reaction. But the reaction when I don’t win, you know what the reaction is? I’m pissed off, big time.
“So we need to be ready for that. This is the environment and this is the reality. Otherwise, we are in Disneyland. We are not in Disneyland. We are in the Premier League at this level and we look after him so much that you cannot imagine. But at the same time, we’re going to demand [from] him like anybody else because he needs to earn the right to play.”
Dowman will be suspended for Sunday’s trip to Liverpool and the games against Hull and Newcastle, while Noni Madueke faces a late test to see if he has recovered from an ankle problem that kept him out of the game against Fleetwood. Arteta also revealed that Bukayo Saka is not expected back until at least after the international break as Arsenal await more news on his thigh injury.
Arteta said they had “put every argument on the table” in an attempt to clear Dowman’s name but to no avail. “Very disappointed,” he said. “Especially with the reckless tackles that he received, and then his reaction is minimal in relation to the action.
“I think you have to read the context of the player, the age, and what happened previously. It could have been really bad. And we are lucky today that he hasn’t had a broken foot. That’s clear.”
hi_body:
आर्सेनल के मैनेजर Mikel Arteta ने 16 वर्षीय Max Dowman को चेतावनी दी है कि वह "डिज्नीलैंड में नहीं हैं"। यह चेतावनी आर्सेनल द्वारा उनके तीन मैचों के प्रतिबंध के खिलाफ की गई अपील के खारिज होने के बाद आई है। डोवमैन को फ्लीटवुड टाउन के खिलाफ लीग कप मैच के दौरान रेड कार्ड मिला था, जिससे वह इस प्रतियोगिता में लाल कार्ड पाने वाले सबसे कम उम्र के खिलाड़ी बन गए, जबकि लीग टू की टीम के खिलाफ आर्सेनल प्रतियोगिता से बाहर हो गई।

### प्रतिबंध और अनुशासनात्मक चिंताएं

* **प्रतिबंध विवरण:** डोवमैन लिवरपूल, हल और न्यूकैसल के खिलाफ आगामी मैचों में नहीं खेल पाएंगे।
* **पिछली घटनाएं:** इस किशोर खिलाड़ी को इस महीने इंग्लैंड अंडर-19 टीम के लिए खेलते हुए भी रेड कार्ड मिला था।
* **अपील का परिणाम:** फुटबॉल एसोसिएशन ने आर्सेनल की अपील को खारिज कर दिया, जिस पर आर्टेटा ने गहरी निराशा व्यक्त की। उन्होंने लापरवाह टैकल का हवाला दिया जिससे खिलाड़ी का पैर टूट सकता था।

### मांग और वास्तविकता पर आर्टेटा की टिप्पणियां

आर्टेटा ने जोर देकर कहा कि युवा खिलाड़ियों को सीनियर स्तर पर गंभीर सजा से बचने के लिए गलतियों से तुरंत सीखना चाहिए।

* **उच्च मांगें:** आर्टेटा ने कहा कि युवा प्रतिभाओं की रक्षा करने के बावजूद, क्लब डोवमैन से किसी भी अन्य खिलाड़ी की तरह उच्च मानकों की मांग करेगा।
* **टीम का माहौल:** मैनेजर ने अपनी प्रतिक्रिया का बचाव करते हुए कहा कि 10 खिलाड़ियों के साथ खेलने का असर टीम के साथियों पर पड़ा था।

### टीम समाचार और चोटें

* **नोनी माडुके:** लिवरपूल के खिलाफ मैच से पहले टखने की समस्या के लिए फिटनेस परीक्षण का सामना कर रहे हैं।
* **बुकायो साका:** जांघ की चोट के कारण कम से कम आगामी अंतरराष्ट्रीय ब्रेक के बाद तक बाहर रहने की उम्मीद है।

व्यावहारिक निहितार्थों में आगामी मैचों के लिए टीम में बदलाव और खिलाड़ी के अनुशासन तथा फिटनेस का प्रबंधन शामिल है। आधिकारिक टीम चयन और घोषणाओं का सत्यापन आर्सेनल के आधिकारिक क्लब संचार और प्रीमियर लीग मैच रिपोर्ट के माध्यम से किया जा सकता है।

en_body:
Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has warned 16-year-old Max Dowman that he "is not in Disneyland" following the rejection of Arsenal's appeal against his three-match suspension. Dowman received a red card during a League Cup match against Fleetwood Town, making him the youngest player ever sent off in the competition as Arsenal exited against the League Two side.

### Suspension and Disciplinary Concerns

* **Suspension details:** Dowman will miss upcoming matches against Liverpool, Hull, and Newcastle.
* **Previous incidents:** The teenager also received a red card this month while playing for the England Under-19 team.
* **Appeal outcome:** The Football Association rejected Arsenal's appeal, which Arteta expressed deep disappointment over, citing reckless tackles that he claimed could have broken the player's foot.

### Arteta's Comments on Demands and Reality

Arteta emphasized that young players must learn quickly from mistakes to avoid severe punishments at the senior level.

* **High demands:** Arteta stated that despite protecting young talents, the club will demand high standards from Dowman like any other squad member.
* **Team environment:** The manager defended his touchline reaction, noting that teammates felt the impact of playing with 10 men.

### Team News and Injuries

* **Noni Madueke:** Faces a late fitness test for an ankle problem ahead of the Liverpool fixture.
* **Bukayo Saka:** Expected to remain sidelined with a thigh injury until at least after the upcoming international break.

Practical implications include squad adjustments for upcoming fixtures while managing player discipline and fitness. Verification of official team selections and announcements can be found through Arsenal's official club communications and Premier League match reports.
